purpose: A1 planning matrix: project-authored single-sentence targets. Recovered from git history after the automated-suite cleanup, annotated with the current construction mapping. This is a planning denominator only and is never a CEFR A1 percentage. Live capability witness status is derived by tests/lib/coverage.mjs from language manifests plus executed approved cases - never stored here.

historicalBasis.note: 23 historical authorial targets (16 concepts, 7 constructions) replayed from the frozen planning matrix. Historical numeric-quantity scope (quantifier.exact 0..20, en/pl) is recorded for future planning; current manifests do not yet witness it.

scope.statement: A1 is a deliberate internal project label for this bounded subset. It is not a CEFR certification and percentages computed over this file must never be presented as a CEFR A1 coverage score.
